union_semantics: true if any available input true; false only if all required inputs available and false; otherwise null; record required/available/missing/positive inputs
matching: Episodes built from complete per-method tri-state series before masks; false/null/cadence gaps break episodes. One event per independent case; credit only onset inside inclusive first..last modified labels; no overlap-only credit, no post-event grace. Rebuild union episodes, never sum component detections.
comparison: Primary strict own-available matches with all events retained, per-method coverage; secondary common-ready onset matches reported separately, never invent onset at mask boundary.
contributions: For each consumption event compute ML_OR vs sustained_high component hit sets, their intersection, ML-only, rule-only and neither. Separately match ML+high OR and report added and lost events relative to ML_OR; an overlapping union may lose onset credit. Do not assume set union equals union-episode matches.
pairing: Fresh inference on each modified stream and untouched original UCI pair; per-point flags/scores, provenance; paired onset counts whole stream and event windows; raw pair is not labeled normal. Additional paired new crossing excludes raw true at matched timestamp; raw null is unavailable, not negative.
warmup: 7 calendar dates from midnight before start; all prefix and 144 post-event intervals. No reset at event. Modified history propagates. Report event/full stream/common coverage, unavailable points and undetected events with null delay.
delay: Minutes between event label and matched alarm onset, detected events only; not wall-clock system latency.
control_semantics: Raw UCI morning is an unmodified observational control, not certified normal. Modeled normal morning replaces energy in all context+observation with 50Wh before08h /200Wh from08h. Benign zero is assumed normal, not verified stuck meter. Controls excluded from target recall.
operations: hold: preceding raw value; high:+200Wh; peak:+400Wh; drop:raw*0.2; ramp:raw+300*(i+1)/n, returns to raw after event; other fields unchanged. Fixed time grid chosen without new score inspection.
telemetry: Flatline vs ML methods reported separately for6 telemetry targets. interval_gap first-return count and timing separately, never consumption detections.
limits: Same previously studied house and viewed historical period, not blind holdout
Synthetic manipulation labels are not real faults
No fitting/calibration/scenario replacement or threshold selection
Unchanged existing local CPU bundle differs from archived original Stage4 binary
All33 scenarios kept including failures; old24-case results only historical separate reference
